title: Roman Villa - Villa Syndexioi (World Save, Schematic)
author: WLhokies

generated.description: A large Roman-style villa built mostly from light gray wool, brick, and brick slabs, set on a dirt and grass platform with a sandy stone courtyard and a tall stone-walled section. It spans about 86 by 86 blocks and is 16 blocks high, with a spruce and birch tree-lined area and interior details like chests, furnaces, a record player, and signs.
